tools.name: get_environment
tools.title: Host environment
tools.description: Return hostname, OS, architecture, agent version, shell, home directory and local policy mode. Relative paths in every tool resolve against the home directory.

tools.name: fs_list
tools.title: List directory
tools.description: List up to 1000 entries of a directory with type, size and modification time.

tools.name: fs_read
tools.title: Read file
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file by byte offset. Pages are at most 64 KiB and never split a character; continue from next_offset.

tools.name: fs_read_many
tools.title: Read several files
tools.description: Read the first page of up to 20 UTF-8 files in one call. A file that cannot be read reports its own error without failing the others.

tools.name: fs_info
tools.title: Path information
tools.description: Report whether a path exists, its type, size, permissions, modification time and symlink target without reading it.

tools.name: fs_glob
tools.title: Find files
tools.description: Find files by glob pattern such as '**/*.rs' under a directory (default home). Skips common dependency/build directories; does not parse .gitignore. Returned matches are sorted newest first.

tools.name: fs_grep
tools.title: Search file contents
tools.description: Search UTF-8 files for a regular expression under a directory (default home), skipping common dependency/build directories (no .gitignore parsing). Returns path, line number and line text. Optional glob filters file names.

tools.name: fs_write
tools.title: Write file
tools.description: Create or fully replace a UTF-8 file atomically. Existing permissions are preserved and symlinks are written through to their target. Prefer fs_edit for changes to existing files.

tools.name: fs_edit
tools.title: Edit file
tools.description: Replace an exact string in a UTF-8 file. old_string must match exactly once unless replace_all is true. Returns a unified diff; on a miss returns the most similar line.

tools.name: fs_move
tools.title: Move or rename
tools.description: Move or rename a file or directory. Refuses to replace an existing destination.

tools.name: fs_mkdir
tools.title: Create directory
tools.description: Create a directory including missing parents. Succeeds when it already exists.

tools.name: shell_exec
tools.title: Run shell command
tools.description: Run a command with the host-native shell (bash/sh on Unix, PowerShell on Windows) using the user's login environment; cwd defaults to home. timeout_s is a waiting limit, not a kill switch: when it elapses the command keeps running as a background job; poll it with job_output.

tools.name: job_list
tools.title: List background jobs
tools.description: List the 100 most recent background jobs with state and exit code.

tools.name: job_output
tools.title: Read job output
tools.description: Read combined stdout/stderr of a background job by byte offset; continue from next_offset.

tools.name: job_kill
tools.title: Stop background job
tools.description: Stop a running background job and its process tree.
